jobs: Rebuild this as a Dark Age Saxon chieftain's hall: a broad, square-planned timber great hall under a steep golden thatched roof with a central smoke louvre and carved beast-head finials, rough vertical oak-plank walls, a small porch on two posts over a plank door, with a short thatched side wing tucked against it so the whole is as deep as it is wide. No cut stone, no masonry, no roof tiles. The building must be compact and square in plan, as deep as it is wide, filling the reference's square footprint diamond exactly and not reaching past it on any side. No long narrow hall stretching away diagonally.

Rebuild this as a Dark Age Greek village hall: a square-planned hall of rough fieldstone and mud-brick around a small inner yard, low timber-and-reed roofs, a simple porch on rough posts, a small wooden cross over the door, a stone well in front. No dome, no banded brick courses, no marble columns, no arcade. The building must be compact and square in plan, as deep as it is wide, filling the reference's square footprint diamond exactly and not reaching past it on any side. No long narrow hall stretching away diagonally.

No ceramic tiles, no upturned eaves, no ridge ornaments, no painted timber. The building must be compact and square in plan, as deep as it is wide, filling the reference's square footprint diamond exactly and not reaching past it on any side. No long narrow hall stretching away diagonally.

The building must be compact and square in plan, as deep as it is wide, filling the reference's square footprint diamond exactly and not reaching past it on any side.
